description: Kinds of requests this deployment does NOT handle. Matching one returns status 'unknown' instead of a weak guess at a supported intent. Remove entries (or this file) if your application supports them.

operate.description: Directly operate a device, app, account or service.

intents.label: control a device, app or account
intents.description: Commands to operate smart-home devices, phones, computers, media players, messaging, calls, payments, money transfers, trading or food delivery.
examples: set the AC to cooling mode
send a message to the team group chat
transfer money to my savings account
order dinner from a nearby restaurant
